items.title: Jimmy Bertrand Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'I used to take Lesman Wren' and 'Then I got bigger than him', but the interviewee (Jimmy Bertrand) does not mention Lesman Wren or confirm any personal interaction.

ctx.x: And he, that's Roy, that's my buddy. And another fellow, let me get them together now, uh, got dog my tootin' time, Art Layfield. Oh yes. Used to be with Paul Ash. Mm-hmm.

That was my tutor too. You remember Paul Ash? Yes, I used to hear him at the theater down there. Oriental was one of those theaters. Well he was at the Oriental and the McVickers. The McVickers, that's where I had him. Yeah. I used to take Lesman Wren. Then I got bigger than him.
I was at the Chicago Fair there. Mm-hmm. I was lookin' down at him. I'm with Eddie South's band now, see. You remember Eddie South? Yeah.
